$schema_note: Pawfolio AI VoxSOAP ML data manifest (feature/voxsoap-model-integration.md §4.7). This file is the PLANNING-TIME manifest. The Colab notebook (Stage 4) rewrites it at runtime with the exact Hub revision SHA, live license strings, discovered split names/fields, and actual row counts. A source whose status is BLOCKED_LICENSE_REVIEW or SKIP_PERMISSION_NOT_VERIFIED must not be used for training, model selection, or a released model.
created_by: coding agent per approved Phase 0 gate, 2026-01

runtime_verification.note: All 'planning_time' values below come from the dataset metadata reviewed while planning the feature document; they are NOT substituted for a live check. inspect_datasets.py / the notebook Stage 4 must capture hub_revision_sha and re-verify every card before any training stage.

gates_policy.rule: A dataset is usable only with APPROVED (or APPROVED_OPTIONAL and explicitly included) status recorded for the CURRENT hub revision. Only the project owner may upgrade a BLOCKED/SKIP status after verifying the license/permission themselves; the agent records, never authorizes.

veterinary_benchmark.status: TO BE PROVIDED BY PROJECT OWNER
veterinary_benchmark.note: Public general corpora are not adequate to evaluate the final Pawfolio task (§8.3). A separate synthetic/de-identified veterinary consultation set (English, Urdu, code-switching, meds/doses/negation, missing vitals, noise, cat/dog cases) must be reviewed by a qualified veterinarian BEFORE being used as a benchmark, and must be kept out of training. The dataset pipeline must not ingest real Pawfolio patient records by default.

runtime_instructions: Stage 4 of ml-training/notebooks/voxsoap_ml_training.ipynb captures hub revisions, licenses, splits, and fields into ml-training/reports/data_manifest_runtime.json (or overwrites this file when --in-place is passed) and aborts any training stage whose gate is not APPROVED/APPROVED_OPTIONAL for the current revision.
